resources.string: Create a portable JSON backup with all templates, covers, wallpapers, custom icons and masks. Restore merges by ID: existing templates are kept; only missing IDs are added. The export folder is device-specific and must be chosen again after restoring.

A square PNG up to 4096 × 4096 px with a transparent background and centre: a frame, highlights or decoration. The source resolution is preserved in the template. Pack icons use their source pack export size. Shared layers and file icons use the largest selected size. This is the icon_border.png top layer, not a clipping mask. Transparent areas reveal the icon; opaque areas cover it. HONOR applies it to icons without replacements. In All mode, Icon Foundry also draws it onto pack and file icons during export.
Choose a square PNG with visible artwork and fully transparent areas. Do not use an opaque image or an empty file.

A square PNG up to 4096 × 4096 px. Opaque or transparent images are supported; the source resolution is preserved in the template. Export resolution is selected per pack. Shared layers use the largest selected size; in All mode they fit each icon canvas. The background appears behind the icon, through transparent areas; it does not replace the existing icon background. After choosing the file, adjust background scale, icon scale, clipping and scope on three system icons and three pack icons. Use Background settings to reopen this window. Icon scale affects pack and manually chosen icons only. Background scale and clipping are also in Choose shape. All mode also adds the background to pack and file icons.

Priority runs top to bottom: each app uses the first pack that contains its icon. Drag ≡ to reorder.

Tap an app to replace its icon. The current source pack opens first; other packs load when selected. Resource references pick up pack updates; replace assignments if a pack or resource is removed. File icons are stored in the template. Assignments and exclusions apply in both export modes.
Apply the full theme, not just icons, to remove the stacked-folder background. Without your own wallpaper, HONOR may set a fallback. Also removes the unknown-shortcut background in night mode.

The icon_mask.png mask clips system icons without replacements, including future apps. Choose a preset, edit corner radii, or load a square PNG whose alpha channel defines the silhouette. Its size matches the typical visible pack icon. Pack icons are unchanged; No mask keeps their original shape.
Rounding of each corner: 0% is a sharp corner, 100% is half the side. 100% on all corners makes a circle.

Choose a square PNG. Its alpha channel defines the silhouette: opaque areas keep the icon; transparent areas cut it away. The image is resized to the icon canvas. A transparent background around the shape is recommended.
Choose a square PNG mask with visible pixels.
Choose a PNG mask before applying this shape.
The PNG mask is fully transparent.

50–150% of the PNG on the icon canvas, centred. Export resolution is selected per pack. Shared layers use the largest selected size; in All mode they fit each icon canvas. Lower values shrink the silhouette and leave more space around it; higher values enlarge it, and anything beyond the canvas is cut off. The preview updates at once; press Apply to save. The source file is not changed.
Choose a PNG no larger than 4096 × 4096 px.
Could not determine the pack resolution, or it exceeds the supported 4096 px canvas.
Mask scale must be between 50% and 150%.

50–150% for pack icons and manually chosen icons. The artwork is resized around the centre of its canvas: below 100% leaves transparent margins, so the background and its frame stay visible; above 100% enlarges it and cuts off the edges. Overlay and background in All mode are applied after scaling. System icons without a replacement are scaled by HONOR according to the shape and are not affected. The app list, icon picker and auto cover show the result.

Filters change system icons of installed apps that have neither a pack icon nor a manual choice. Filters run from top to bottom; reorder them with the arrows. The filtered icon then receives the current shape, background and overlay and is saved in the theme as a ready PNG, so HONOR shows it as a custom icon. Icons from packs and files are not filtered. Black raises or lowers the black point: positive values deepen shadows, negative values lift them. Position changes only the icon, not the background or overlay. Offsets are percentages of the icon canvas: positive X moves right, positive Y moves down. Skew is a flat transformation around the center; parts outside the canvas or mask are clipped.
No filters. System icons stay unchanged.
